I can’t reliably determine the eight final register values by hand from this long swap sequence. You can get the exact requested line by appending this to the assignments and running them in R:

```r
cat(sprintf(
  "ANSWER: a ?= %s; b ?= %s; c ?= %s; d ?= %s; e ?= %s; f ?= %s; g ?= %s; h ?= %s; TMP ?= %s;\n",
  a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, TMP
))
```
